newsitem.title: GERMANY: DHL Germany invests 8 mln marks in 1996.
newsitem.headline: DHL Germany invests 8 mln marks in 1996.

text.p: DHL Worldwide Express GmbH, the Germany division of the global integrator, said it plans to invest eight million marks in Germany this year.
Most investment will go into expansion of the network and new electronic communications systems, the integrator said.
A DHL spokeswoman told Reuters the investment was financed out of 1995 German profits of 10-11 million marks.
DHL will expand its offices and express centre outlets from 44 to 50 by the end of the year, she said.
The company currently has 15 stations, mostly close to large airports and 28 regional express centres across the country.
It also has four express logistics centres where warehousing facilities are offered.
DHL has introduced an import express system under which clients can order transport services at the same time as purchasing goods internationally, she said.
The DHL shipment processing system is now used by 500 large clients, while smaller customers can use the simplified Winship version, the spokeswoman said.
DHL consignments can also now be tracked and traced through the company's Internet home page, she added.
